mapper.sql: SELECT t.training_id AS trainingId, t.title AS trainingName, -- training_name 대신 title 사용 t.trainer_id AS trainerId, u.username AS trainerName, -- 트레이너 이름 추가 t.approval_status AS approvalStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.training_id = t.training_id) AS totalStudents, -- trainee_enrollment 대신 enrollments 사용 DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS requestDate -- 신청일 추가 FROM trainings t -- training 대신 trainings 사용 JOIN trainer_profiles tp ON t.trainer_id = tp.trainer_id JOIN users u ON tp.trainer_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.approval_status = '승인' -- 'APPROVED' 대신 '승인' 사용 ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
WHERE t.approval_status = '대기' -- 'PENDING' 대신 '대기' 사용 ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
